# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.10 — P0 regression recovery

<!-- update-summary: Preview.10 keeps Smart Drag candidates invisible until positive file-like OLE evidence, hardens the borderless Dynamic Island HWND boundary, and completes explicit source-safe Quick Action image exports. -->

Preview.10 is a release-blocking recovery Preview. It preserves the Preview.9
shell-intake and Undo contracts while tightening the two places where a false
positive or an unsafe export would be most costly.

## Smart Drag false-activation recovery

- Pointer movement, Windows drag-threshold crossing, Explorer/Desktop source
  attribution, accessibility drag-start signals, and an active OLE loop create
  only an invisible candidate.
- Every Smart candidate uses the single bounded, query-only OLE probe. The
  Dynamic Island becomes visible only after `CF_HDROP`, a Shell Item array, or
  the `FileGroupDescriptorW` + `FileContents` descriptor pair is positively
  classified as file-like.
- The hollow probe remains non-activating, a tool window, topmost only for its
  short lifetime, and returns `DROPEFFECT_NONE`. Rejected, timed-out, late,
  duplicate, and stale callbacks cannot reveal or reopen a session.

## Borderless native Dynamic Island

- The visual HWND now forces popup/no-caption/non-client-free styles after the
  WinUI presenter is configured, with checked Win32 and DWM results.
- Physical client geometry is checked against the fixed host at placement and
  every animated HRGN frame. A critical native or geometry failure leaves the
  window hidden and emits path-free numeric diagnostics.
- Windows 10 retains the solid/base visual. Windows 11 corner and border DWM
  attributes remain optional enhancements and never determine correctness.

## Quick Action exports

- Hash, ZIP, QR, resize, conversion, and metadata actions default to the
  dedicated user-writable `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\DropSpace\\exports` directory or an
  explicitly chosen folder.
- Outputs reserve names atomically and never overwrite the current source or
  an existing export. Results show the output path and map access, source,
  parameter, invalid-data, cancellation, and output failures to localized
  messages.
- Image resize requires width and height. Conversion requires an explicit
  format and preserves source dimensions when both optional size fields are
  blank. Metadata stripping creates a new format-selected export.
- Main and Dynamic Island primary actions use the same parameter dialog and
  central registry/capability authority.

## Validation boundary

The release workflow remains authoritative for the Core/Infrastructure tests,
WinUI build, Portable EXE, Installer, unsigned MSIX, lifecycle smoke, checksums,
update manifest, and official website/API synchronization. This Preview is
**CONDITIONAL** until hosted Windows and hands-on evidence covers historical
Windows versions, mixed-DPI multi-monitor placement, native border leaks,
Explorer/provider cursor feedback, false Smart reveals, and the Quick Action
parameter/error matrix. Linux/static checks do not replace that evidence.

## 中文说明

- Preview.10 保留 Preview.9 的 Shell 入站和撤销契约；Smart Drag 候选在获得正面的文件类 OLE 证据之前始终不可见。
- 动态岛 HWND 现在检查 Win32、DWM、非客户区和 HRGN 几何结果；关键失败会保持隐藏。Windows 10 使用基础视觉，Windows 11 的 DWM 属性仅作为可选增强。
- 哈希、ZIP、二维码、图像调整大小、格式转换和元数据清除使用专用导出目录、原子化不覆盖命名、明确的图像参数和本地化错误；不会覆盖当前源文件。
- 本 Preview 仍为 **CONDITIONAL（有条件完成）**，需要真实 Windows、Explorer/提供程序、光标反馈、DPI、边框泄漏和 Quick Action 矩阵证据。

Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview. Select the Preview
channel only to test the recovery behavior.
